meta.description: Case-development alerting pipeline (M5): a WhatsApp-style status webhook is mirrored into a local-only n8n Webhook node, then PII-scrubbed (fail-closed), then routed by severity to the closed lawyers' Telegram channel — every outbound message carries the MANDATORY legal disclaimer. App pushes via FCM/OneSignal are a roadmap item; this n8n pipeline is the notification backbone meanwhile.

nodes.name: استقبال تحديث القضية (Webhook)
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/crimsys-case-alert  { caseCode, event, titleAr?, detailsAr?, severity? }  — Caller must be inside ai-internal (e.g. another container) or local 127.0.0.1; the endpoint is NOT exposed to the internet (n8n binds 127.0.0.1:5678 on the host). Severity must be one of: info, warning, critical.
